messages.subject: OOB and Validation?
parts:
Hi

I ran rf in rattle and got "OOB estimate of  error rate: 41.9%".

Then I ran the Evaluate/Error matrix/forest/Validation and got  "Overall error: 0.2352941"

I know that rf is never exactly the same but the size of the OOB and the Validation is different. What is the difference?

Kind regards,

Rolf

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: OOB and Validation?
parts:
OOB is using the training set data (70% of the full dataset) - making use of the sample not used in building the tree(s) to do the calculations. The rattle validation set is a hold-out dataset of 15% of the full dataset

Graham Williams
